# PocketGull Typeface Superfamily

> Open-source ophthalmological and clinical typeface superfamily engineered for Louise Sloan 5:1 optotypic legibility, ISO/TR 11548 256-glyph Unicode Braille, and ISMP life-critical medication safety.

## Overview
- **Name**: PocketGull
- **Designer**: Phil Gear (ORCID: 0009-0008-1372-5381)
- **Publisher**: PocketGull LLC
- **License**: SIL Open Font License 1.1 (100% Free & Open Source)
- **Repository**: https://github.com/pocketgull-app/pocketgull-typeface
- **Specimen**: https://typeface.pocketgull.app/
- **CERN / Zenodo Archival**: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.20647514 (Companion)
- **Citation File**: https://typeface.pocketgull.app/CITATION.cff

## 4 Coordinated Masters
1. **PocketGull Bold (700)**: Triage warnings and headline acuity.
2. **PocketGull Fineliner (400)**: Clinical progress notes and humanized reading.
3. **PocketGull Chiseltip (900)**: Dynamic calligraphic display and brand mark.
4. **PocketGull Mono (400)**: 600 UPM fixed-pitch telemetry and ICU vitals.

## Clinical Safety Features
- `cv08` Slashed Zero (0 vs O)
- Curved lowercase l, footed capital I, and hooked numeral 1
- Herman Bouma 0.12em lateral anti-crowding geometry
- 670nm Retinal Photobiomodulation (PBM) zero-blue-light circadian preservation mode
